business_question: Does Apple's semiconductor supply chain create hidden concentration risk through a single geography?
description: Apple depends on TSMC as a near-sole-source supplier for Apple Silicon chips. TSMC's primary fabrication capacity is concentrated in Taiwan. Taiwan faces persistent geopolitical risk from cross-strait tensions. An investor holding Apple may not recognise that a geopolitical event in Taiwan could simultaneously disrupt Apple's ability to manufacture its most profitable products.
future_expansion: Add ASML as a second-order supplier dependency (TSMC depends on ASML for EUV lithography)
Add rare earth elements as a commodity exposure node for Apple Silicon manufacturing
Add China revenue concentration as a separate Currency Exposure pattern case
Add alternative fab geographies (Arizona TSMC fab) as a mitigant node once operational
Add Foxconn assembly concentration in China as a Labour Exposure case
evidence: Apple 10-K FY2024: TSMC identified as sole-source supplier for Apple Silicon processors
Apple 10-K FY2024: Greater China segment represents approximately 19% of net revenue
TSMC Annual Report 2023: Over 90% of advanced node capacity located in Taiwan
US DoD: Taiwan Strait identified as high-priority geopolitical risk corridor
